meta.title: Watching a quarterly job with a daily metric

views.label: Writing the expectation
views.note: Every run records what we are waiting for next, and arrivals clear it.

views.label: Watching it daily
views.note: The sweeper turns a rare event into a number CloudWatch sees every day.

components.label: Expectations table
components.sublabel: one row per thing we await

cards.title: Why the native alarm cannot work
items: Period times evaluation periods caps at seven days for a period of an hour or more
A quarterly job leaves a ninety day gap between runs
Alarm history is kept for thirty days, so the forensics do not span one cycle

cards.title: What the design changes
items: The expectation is durable state, held where CloudWatch cannot hold it
The metric is continuous even though the thing it describes is rare
One sweeper covers run deadlines and return file deadlines alike

cards.title: What it costs
items: The sweeper is now the thing that must not fail silently, and it runs daily
A manual rerun that does not clear the row raises a false alarm
That is the direction of error worth having
